purpose: Dedicated blob team for the listener, stream, cache, deployment and UI-state failures observed during the 2026-09-01 GThink public-page incident.

teams.name: Listener Sentinel
teams.mission: Track gthink.listener.ready, responder TTL, probe/ready timing and missing listener announcements.

teams.name: Pending Loopback
teams.mission: Detect gateway.request responses that exist locally but fail to resolve the waiting request.

teams.name: Channel Bridge
teams.mission: Check the v2/v1 BroadcastChannel bridge and detect missing cross-channel propagation.

teams.name: Cache Scout
teams.mission: Verify that the expected responder/person/bus script versions are actually loaded by the page.

teams.name: UI State Auditor
teams.mission: Compare the visible GThink status with runtime responder/transport state and flag contradictions.

teams.name: Regression Runner
teams.mission: Run deterministic listener/transport/status checks without sending destructive traffic.

teams.name: Night Ops Supervisor
teams.mission: Aggregate incidents, deduplicate repeated faults and expose one factual health snapshot.
